title: tool/device_e2e/journey_01_signup_profile.py promises TEST_UID cleanup that nothing implements
why: Every run of this journey creates a real Firebase Auth account + Firestore learner_profiles doc in the live torah-study-tracker project and prints TEST_UID with a comment implying something downstream consumes it to clean up. Grepping the whole repo finds no script, doc, or Makefile target that reads a TEST_UID= line from this journey's output — nothing ever deletes the test account or its Firestore docs. Repeated manual runs (the file's own comment: 'Local-only dev tool... run: python3 journey_01_signup_profile.py') accumulate orphaned e2e<timestamp>@example.com accounts and profile documents in the production-named Firebase project indefinitely.
recommendation: Either add the promised cleanup step (a small script that reads TEST_UID from stdout/a file and deletes the Identity Toolkit account + its Firestore docs) or remove the misleading '# for cleanup' comment and note in the README that test accounts must be purged manually/periodically.
acceptance_criteria: Either a cleanup script consuming TEST_UID exists and is documented in tool/device_e2e/README.md, or the cleanup comment is removed/replaced with an accurate note about manual purging.
